review_candidates.title: Infrastructure / Cloud Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job description: Scope We're looking for an Infrastructure / Cloud Platform Engineer to join the IT Infrastructure team within IT Corporate. You'll take end-to-end ownership of our infrastructure platforms—both on-premises and Microsoft Azure—using automation and DevOps practices to keep services reliable, scalable, and secure. The role blends hands-on operations with engineering and platform evolution, working closely with Security, DevOps, Workplace, and Application teams to support our digital transformation. As EVS is an NIS2 Essential Entity implementing ISO/IEC 27001:2022, you'll also help drive secure-by-design infrastructure, compliance, and audit readiness. We're looking for someone technically strong, hands-on, and proactive about innovation and operational excellence. Job Description As part of the Core IT Infrastructure team, the Infrastructure Engineer will contribute to the following activities: Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Manage and monitor hybrid infrastructure (on-prem + Azure cloud) Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of platforms Handle incident, problem, and change management processes Provide 2nd and 3rd level support for complex infrastructure issues Conduct root cause analysis and deliver long-term fixes Cloud & Platform Engineering Design, deploy, and operate Azure infrastructure (IaaS & PaaS) Support platform standardization and scalability efforts Take part in architecture design and technical roadmap discussions DevOps & Automation Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) Help develop CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git) Streamline operational tasks through automation (PowerShell, scripting) Champion DevOps culture across the team Security & Compliance (ISO27001) Apply security baselines, patching, and hardening standards Assist with ISO27001 controls implementation and compliance Work alongside InfoSec on vulnerability management and remediation Help ensure audit readiness and supporting documentation Resilience & Continuity Uphold backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans Participate in testing and enhancing recovery processes Continuous Improvement Track performance and identify optimization opportunities Support capacity planning and Azure cost optimization (FinOps awareness) Suggest improvements to infrastructure, processes, and tools Documentation & Knowledge Sharing Produce and update technical documentation and knowledge base Share best practices and help upskill the team Profile Strong knowledge of: Hybrid infrastructure (on-prem + cloud) Azure services (compute, networking, identity, storage, ..) OS (Windows / Linux) Practical experience with: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) CI/CD and DevOps tooling (Azure DevOps, Git) Automation (PowerShell, scripting) Good understanding of: Virtualization (VMware / Proxmox) Networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, firewall) Backup & DR solutions Security best practices and ISO27001 controls Acts as: Technical expert in one or more domains Reference point for complex technical topics Personal Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset Organized, structured & detail-oriented Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams Curious & willing to continuously learn new technologies and security trends Proactive attitude and continuous improvement mindset Strong communication & coordination skills Team player with a practical and solution-oriented approach Languages Fluent in French (working language of the IT team) Professional English required (working language of EVS world wide) Offer Becoming part of the EVS team means receiving a competitive salary aligned with your skills and market standards, along with a wide range of wellness and healthcare benefits. Our flexible schedules and hybrid working policies help support work–life balance. EVS also provides opportunities for career growth, internal mobility, and a broad range of training programs. You will join a friendly, lively, and inclusive environment that values motivation and ambition. Visit our website to learn more about why you should join EVS!

review_candidates.description: About StoredTech We strive to provide innovative solutions, exceptional service, and a relentless focus on client success. Our mission is to empower our clients to thrive in the digital world by delivering reliable, cutting-edge technology with a personal touch. StoredTech is a fast-growing Managed Services Provider (MSP) delivering cutting-edge IT solutions that help businesses scale efficiently and securely. With a strong focus on client success, innovation, and reliability, we support organizations across multiple industries with managed IT, cloud services, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. Position Summary As a Systems Engineer I, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality technical support to our clients, ensuring their IT systems operate smoothly and efficiently. You will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, providing timely and effective solutions, and delivering outstanding client delight! Key Responsibilities (Essential Functions) Provide technical support to clients via phone, email, and remote assistance tools. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues promptly and efficiently. Delight the customer while supporting either from office or in-person/onsite. Work closely with other engineers to ensure required dependencies are being met. Demonstrate initiative, independent judgment and utilize established procedures to address client needs. Escalate complex technical issues to appropriate teams or senior technicians for resolution. Support, Install, configure, and maintain hardware and software systems. Document all technical support interactions, solutions provided, and resolutions achieved. Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and best practices. Perform any additional job duties as requested by management to contribute to the overall success of the organization. Perform other related duties as assigned to support team and company objectives. Required Qualifications Experience troubleshooting M365. 1-3 years’ experience in a technical support role. Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems. Experience with troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues. A strong foundation in IT concepts, including hardware and software troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to analyze and diagnose technical issues efficiently, employing critical thinking and logic to identify root causes and implement effective solutions. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are crucial for effectively interacting with clients. The ability to work collaboratively with other technical support specialists, engineers, and teams within the organization to share knowledge, escalate issues when necessary, and contribute to a positive team environment. Strong documentation skills to accurately record all technical support interactions, solutions provided, and resolutions achieved. Leidos is a major partner on the contract and will provide a substantial portion of the cybersecurity workforce supporting the Defense Human Resources Activity (DHRA) and DMDC. The Network Engineer will support external network-connectivity compliance and the technical approval processes required to connect DHRA systems, applications, and services across Department of Defense network boundaries. This position will review network implementations, firewall requirements, ports, protocols, services, and connection requests to ensure technical solutions comply with Department of Defense and Defense Information Systems Agency requirements. Mission Environment DMDC supports the Defense Human Resources Activity within the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness (OUSD(P&R)) and maintains the Department of Defense’s largest and most comprehensive central repository of personnel, manpower, casualty, pay, entitlement, personnel security, identity, readiness, training, and related data. The DHRA Information Technology (IT) environment includes approximately 15,000 network and endpoint devices supporting more than 600 Government-Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) applications and approximately 100 Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization boundaries managed through the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS). External connectivity within this environment is governed through Department of Defense registration, approval, and compliance processes. DHRA processes approximately 500 Ports, Protocols, and Services Management (PPSM) requests annually and maintains a significant inventory of approved enterprise whitelist entries. The Network Engineer will help ensure required connectivity is implemented without creating unauthorized or unmanaged pathways across Department of Defense network boundaries. Review technical network implementations to ensure compliance with Department of Defense connectivity and cybersecurity requirements. Review firewall requests and evaluate required ports, protocols, application services, communication paths, and network boundaries. Prepare, review, submit, and track Ports, Protocols, and Services Management requests for registration and technical implementation. Validate PPSM requests for completeness, technical accuracy, and compliance before submission. Identify the ports, protocols, application services, and network boundaries associated with proposed communications. Review proposed connectivity against applicable Department of Defense requirements and the Connection Approval List (CAL). Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or noncompliant requests and work with requestors and technical stakeholders to resolve deficiencies. Support exception processing, including Component Local Service Assessment (CLSA) actions when required. Maintain the accuracy and compliance of existing PPSM registrations and support auditing of registered connectivity against actual technical implementations. Review technical firewall implementations associated with approved connectivity requests. Support the Connection Approval Process (CAP) and Systems/Network Approval Process (SNAP), including data collection, submission, deficiency resolution, renewals, exceptions, and status tracking. Ensure connectivity approval requests meet applicable Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) requirements. Support enterprise whitelisting processes, including creation, review, registration, implementation, maintenance, and compliance of whitelist entries. Work with system and product owners to maintain accurate connectivity and whitelist registrations. Develop and maintain tactics, techniques, and procedures and other process documentation for connectivity registration, approval, compliance, auditing, exception processing, and renewals. Maintain accurate inventories and status information for connectivity requests, registrations, and approvals. Translate complex network requirements into technical design and implementation plans.
